user.title: Water bill
user.description: Pick the index sensor of your meter, for instance « Compteur eau - Volume total » from the wM-Bus meter. One bill per meter.

tarif.title: Tariff source
tarif.description: Where does the water price come from?

prereglage.title: Your local authority's tariff
prereglage.description: Tariffs taken from official decisions. Your town is missing? See the contribution guide in the repository.

data.assainissement: Connected to the public sewer (collective sanitation)

prix_fixe.title: Fixed price
prix_fixe.description: Average price per m³ including VAT and subscription (from your last bill, for instance).

releve.title: Last meter reading
releve.description: Copy the date and index of your last bill: the cost is computed from that reading.

data.date_releve: Start of the billing period (last reading)

data_description.facturation: The period starts on the reading date: for example 3 months from April 1st for a quarterly bill.
data_description.date_releve: Start date of the period, shown on your last bill (last meter reading).

entite_prix.title: Price entity
entite_prix.description:
Pick a price-per-m³ sensor, for example "Total price" from the HydroTarif integration (SISPEA data for your municipality).

Note: this is an **average price** computed on a 120 m³/year bill, standing charges included. There are no tiers and no separate standing charge, and the "next m³ price" equals this average price, not the true marginal price. A preset for your water authority is more accurate when available.

taux_facture.title: Last bill rate
taux_facture.description: Enter the total (incl. VAT) and volume of your last bill: the price used will be total ÷ volume, standing charges included. It is an average price without tiers. It is updated every time you enter a bill with the "Enter a bill" action.

diametre.title: Meter diameter
diametre.description: This tariff's standing charge depends on the meter diameter (DN, in mm), printed on the bill or on the meter. DN 15 is the most common for a house.

error.unite: The index must be in m³ or L.
error.state_class: The sensor must be a cumulative index (state_class total_increasing or total).
error.index_incoherent: This index is above the current meter index.
error.date_future: The date is in the future.
error.unite_prix: The sensor must be a price per m³ (unit €/m³).
error.prix_indisponible: This sensor's price is currently unavailable.
error.volume_nul: Volume must be greater than zero.

abort.already_configured: This sensor already has a bill.

saisir_facture.name: Enter a bill
saisir_facture.description: Compares a received bill with the calculation, stores it in the history and resets the meter reading (date and index) to this bill.

debut.name: Period start
debut.description: Previous meter reading date, printed on the bill.

fin.name: Period end
fin.description: Meter reading date of this bill.

volume.name: Billed volume
volume.description: Consumption for the period, in m³.

index_releve.name: Meter index
index_releve.description: Meter index at the end of the period. Without it, the reading moves forward by the billed volume if the bill starts at the current reading.

entree_inconnue.message: tarifeau entry not found or not loaded.

periode_invalide.message: The period end must be after its start.

date_future.message: The period end is in the future.

index_incoherent.message: The meter index exceeds the current meter index ({actuel} m³).

ecart_facture.title: {nom}: {ecart_pct} % difference with the bill
ecart_facture.description:
The bill from {debut} to {fin} is {montant} €, while the calculation gives {calcul} €: more than {seuil} % apart.

Possible causes: the tariff changed (pick an up-to-date preset or report it in the repository), a leak, a replaced meter or a typo. This alert goes away with the next bill within the threshold.
